headline: Know which rooms are ready instantly
body: Your front desk sees room status updates the moment housekeeping finishes. No internal phone calls. Faster check-ins.
caption:
Guests are waiting in your lobby after a long safari. Your front desk team is calling housekeeping to check if room 204 is ready.

With Operra, the moment housekeeping updates a room's status, the front desk sees it instantly. No internal phone calls. No manual checks. Just faster check-ins.

headline: Kufunga hesabu za siku hakupaswi kuchukua masaa
body: Unapoteza muda kulinganisha risiti za bar, mkahawa na mapokezi? Operra inakusanya kila muamala mahali pamoja bila usumbufu.
caption:
Ushawahi kubaki mapokezi mpaka saa nane za usiku ukitafuta wapi hesabu za siku hazikubaliani?

Kulinganisha mauzo ya vinywaji, chakula na vyumba kwenye madaftari kunachosha na kunafungua mwanya wa kupoteza pesa. Operra inakuonyesha ripoti kamili ya kila zamu na historia ya kila muamala papo hapo, hata mtandao ukiwa wa kuunga unga.

Punguza msongo wa mawazo kwenye hesabu zako.

headline: Kila idara inatumia mfumo kwa lugha inayoielewa
body: Wafanyakazi wa mapokezi na usafi wanatumia mfumo mmoja kwa Kiswahili au Kiingereza. Kazi zinaenda bila kukwama wala kuhitaji mafunzo magumu.
caption:
Hoteli nyingi zinapata usumbufu pale wafanyakazi wanaposhindwa kutumia mifumo yenye Kiingereza kigumu.

Mfumo wa Operra una muundo wa Kiswahili na Kiingereza, hivyo kila mfanyakazi—kutoka mapokezi hadi usafi—anaingiza taarifa kwa usahihi. Unapata ripoti za uendeshaji na hesabu bila kuchelewa wala kupoteza taarifa za kila siku.

Rahisisha usimamizi wa hoteli yako kupitia operra.tech

headline: Kagua usafi wa chumba kabla ya kumpa mteja ufunguo
body: Usimamizi mzuri wa vyumba unahitaji ukaguzi wa haraka wa maeneo makuu matano kabla chumba hakijaripotiwa kuwa tayari kwenye mfumo.
caption:
Mteja kuingia kwenye chumba kilichosafishwa nusu ni kosa linaloharibu sifa ya hoteli yako mara moja.

Hakikisha kila asubuhi msimamizi wa usafi anakagua mambo makuu matano: usafi wa bafu, taulo mpya, viyoyozi vinavyofanya kazi, taa, na harufu ya chumba kabla ya kubadili hali ya chumba kuwa Tayari.

Operra inasaidia timu yako ya usafi kutoa taarifa za vyumba vilivyo tayari papo hapo bila kupiga simu mapokezi.

headline: Every price change and payment tracked in one place
body: See exactly who adjusted a rate, posted a payment, or checked in a guest. Complete accountability across your team.
caption:
When cash doesn't balance or a room rate gets altered, finding out what happened shouldn't take hours of detective work.

Operra logs every booking change, payment, and rate adjustment across your front desk and POS with staff names and timestamps. Keep your operations transparent and your revenue protected.

See how it works at operra.tech.

beats: Who changed rates at your desk?
See every payment and guest check-in.

reel.narration: Stop wondering who authorized that discount. With Operra, every single rate change, payment, and check-in is logged. Even on low-bandwidth connections, our bilingual system gives you a complete audit trail so you can run your property with total confidence.

headline: Bili za bar kuhamia kwenye chumba cha mteja papo hapo
body: Mteja akila au kunywa, gharama inaingia kwenye akaunti ya chumba chake papo hapo. Hakuna makaratasi kupotea.
caption:
Umewahi kupoteza mapato kwa sababu bili ya vinywaji au chakula haikufika mapokezi kabla mteja hajaondoka? Ni changamoto ya kawaida sana kwenye hoteli nyingi.

Ukiwa na Operra, huduma zote za bar na mgahawa zimeunganishwa moja kwa moja na mapokezi. Mteja akiagiza chochote, gharama inaingia kwenye akaunti yake mara moja. Wakati wa kuondoka, bili inasomeka ikiwa kamili bila kupoteza muda.

headline: Kugongana kwa vyumba mapokezi
body: Operra inaonyesha hali halisi ya kila chumba kwa sekunde ileile. Hakuna tena makosa ya kupanga wateja wawili chumba kimoja.
caption:
Inaumiza sana mteja anapofika mapokezi usiku na kukuta chumba alicholipa kimepewa mteja mwingine kwa makosa ya mawasiliano.

Operra inamaliza fujo hii. Mfumo wetu unasasisha hali ya vyumba papo hapo, iwe ni kupitia simu au kompyuta. Kila idara inaona chumba kilicho wazi na kilichojaa kwa sekunde hiyo hiyo, kuzuia kabisa double-booking.
imagePrompt: A minimalist, dark-themed background featuring clean architectural lines of a modern boutique hotel corridor. Low-contrast, right-of-centre composition with no people, no text, and no logos. Color-graded in dark violet #a478ff and deep teal #36d2ba to allow text overlay on the left.

beats: Wateja wawili chumbani huleta aibu kubwa.
Mfumo wa Operra unazuia makosa haya.
Hali ya vyumba inaonekana papo hapo.
Mapokezi tulivu na wateja wenye furaha.
reel.narration: Kupanga wateja wawili chumba kimoja ni aibu kubwa kwa hoteli yako. Ukiwa na Operra, unaona hali halisi ya kila chumba kwa sekunde ileile. Inafanya kazi vizuri hata mtandao ukiwa chini, ikihakikisha mapokezi yako yanakuwa tulivu na yenye ufanisi kila siku.

headline: 6 core hotel operations in one simple system
body: Track your front desk, housekeeping, POS, pricing, reports, and audit trail inside Operra without switching between different apps.
caption:
Running a hotel shouldn't mean logging into five different systems every morning. When your front desk, POS, and housekeeping don't talk to each other, payments slip through the cracks.

Operra connects all 6 core departments into one simple platform. Keep your entire team aligned and every shilling accounted for.
